sn41.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Macchikāsande viharanti Ambātakavane || || 2
sn41.2:1.2: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati there bhikkhū etad avoca ||
sn41.2:1.3: Adhivāsentu me bhante therā svātanāya bhattanti || ||
sn41.2:1.5: Atha kho Citto gahapati therānam bhikkhūnam adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 5
sn41.2:1.6: Atha kho therā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Cittassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu || || 6
sn41.2:2.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati āyasmantam Theram etad avoca ||
sn41.2:2.2: Dhātunānattaṃ dhātunānattan ti bhante Thera vuccati ||
sn41.2:2.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn41.2:2.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Thero tuṇhi ahosi || || 8
sn41.2:2.5: Dutiyam pi kho Citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca ||
sn41.2:2.7: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatāti || ||
sn41.2:2.8: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Thero tuṇhi ahosi || || 9
sn41.2:2.9: Tatiyam pi kho Citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca ||
sn41.2:2.11: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn41.2:2.12: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Thero tuṇhi ahosi || || 10
sn41.2:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Isidatto tasmim bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti || || 11
sn41.2:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Isidatto āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca || ||
sn41.2:3.3: Vyākaromaham bhante thera Cittassa gahapatino etam pañhanti || ||
sn41.2:3.4: Vyākarohi tvam Isidatta Cittassa gahapatino etam pañhanti || || 12
sn41.2:3.7: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn41.2:3.9: Idaṃ kho gahapati dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatā ||
sn41.2:3.12: ettāvatā nu kho gahapati dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatāti || || 13
sn41.2:4.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati āyasmato Isidattassa bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā there bhikkhū paṇitena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi || || 14
sn41.2:4.2: Atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu || || 15
sn41.2:4.3: Atha kho āyasmā Thero āyasmantam Isidattam etad avoca ||
sn41.2:4.4: Sādhu kho tvam āvuso Isidatta eso pañho paṭibhāsi neso pañho mam paṭibhāsi ||
sn41.2:4.5: tena hāvuso Isidatta yadā aññadā pi evarūpo pañho āgaccheyya || taññevettha paṭibhāseyyāti || || 1
